description: Vision Transformer model by Google for image classification. Pre-trained on ImageNet-21k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k. Best at: 1,000-class image classification at 224x224 resolution. Typical uses: object recognition, image tagging, transfer learning backbone. Not suited for: real-time inference on resource-constrained devices.

Fine-tuned Vision Transformer for content moderation. Trained on 80,000 diverse images with binary classification (normal/NSFW). Best at: detecting inappropriate images for content filtering. Domains: social media, user-generated content platforms. Typical uses: photo review pipelines, automated content screening. Not suited for: nuanced aesthetic judgments.

ResNet-18 architecture trained on ImageNet-1k via timm library. Lightweight 11.7M parameter model for image classification. Best at: efficient 1,000-class image recognition. Typical uses: feature extraction, backbone for downstream tasks, real-time inference. Not suited for: small object detection or pixel-level tasks.

PaddleOCR document layout analysis model for page structure understanding. Best at: detecting document regions, text blocks, tables, and figures in PDFs and scans. Domains: document processing, data extraction. Typical uses: invoice parsing, document digitization, form extraction. Not suited for: handwritten content analysis.

Table Transformer (DETR) for recognizing table structure. Fine-tuned on PubTables1M dataset. Best at: identifying table rows, columns, and cells from document images. Domains: scientific papers, financial documents. Typical uses: document parsing, table extraction pipelines. Not suited for: detecting tables without clear grid structure.

Real-Time DETR (RT-DETR) end-to-end object detector by Peking University. Trained on COCO and Objects365. Best at: fast real-time detection with high accuracy (54.3% AP on COCO). Typical uses: surveillance, autonomous vehicles, live video analysis. Not suited for: tiny object detection.

YOLOS (You Only Look at One Sequence) small Vision Transformer for object detection. Trained on COCO 2017 with DETR loss. Best at: general object detection with transformer architecture. Typical uses: real-time video object tracking, scene understanding. Not suited for: dense prediction or segmentation.

Table Transformer (DETR) for detecting table regions in documents. Fine-tuned on PubTables1M. Best at: localizing table boundaries in document pages. Domains: document analysis, digital archiving. Typical uses: document preprocessing, automated table extraction. Not suited for: detecting complex nested layouts.

CLIPSeg model for zero-shot and one-shot image segmentation. Combines CLIP with segmentation capability. Best at: segmenting objects based on text or image prompts without task-specific training. Typical uses: interactive image editing, visual search, content removal. Not suited for: real-time inference on edge devices.

BiRefNet for high-resolution dichotomous image segmentation (salient object detection). Produces binary masks separating foreground from background. Best at: precise object/subject extraction at 1024x1024 resolution. Domains: photography, e-commerce, design. Typical uses: product background removal, portrait extraction. Not suited for: multi-class semantic segmentation.

RMBG-2.0 model for background removal and object segmentation. Specialized image segmentation model for isolating foreground objects. Best at: removing backgrounds from photos. Typical uses: product photography, portrait editing, image composition. Not suited for: multi-class semantic segmentation.

description: Mask2Former model trained on Cityscapes semantic segmentation with Swin backbone. Transformer-based architecture with masked attention. Best at: urban scene segmentation into 30+ semantic classes. Domains: autonomous driving, city planning. Typical uses: street scene analysis, autonomous navigation. Not suited for: real-time inference on constrained hardware.

SegFormer-B0 lightweight semantic segmentation model fine-tuned on ADE20k at 512x512. Efficient Transformer encoder with MLP decoder. Best at: fast scene understanding across 150+ semantic categories. Typical uses: real-time scene parsing, robotics, edge deployment. Not suited for: high-resolution inference without optimization.

Depth Anything V2 Small for monocular depth estimation. Trained on 595K synthetic + 62M unlabeled real images. Best at: zero-shot depth prediction with fine-grained details and robustness. Domains: 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous systems. Typical uses: depth map generation, 3D scene understanding. Not suited for: metric depth without calibration.

DPT-Hybrid (MiDaS 3.0) monocular depth estimator by Intel. Vision Transformer backbone trained on 1.4M images (MIX 6 dataset). Best at: zero-shot cross-dataset depth estimation. Typical uses: 3D scene reconstruction, augmented reality, robotics. Not suited for: fine-tuning without substantial data.

Depth Anything 3 Metric Large for metric depth estimation in monocular settings. 350M parameter model. Best at: real-world scale depth prediction with camera intrinsics and poses. Capabilities: relative depth, metric depth, sky segmentation. Typical uses: 3D mapping, real estate analysis. Not suited for: video sequences without temporal consistency.

SDXL base model for text-to-image generation by Stability AI. Ensemble-of-experts pipeline with optional refinement. Best at: photorealistic image synthesis from text prompts at various resolutions. Typical uses: creative design, prototyping, content generation. Not suited for: consistent character generation, precise text rendering.

Stable Diffusion v1.5 latent diffusion model for text-to-image generation. Fine-tuned on LAION aesthetics dataset at 512x512. Best at: generating diverse photorealistic images from text. Typical uses: illustration, product mockups, artwork generation. Not suited for: high-resolution output, complex spatial relationships.

SDXL-Turbo fast text-to-image model using Adversarial Diffusion Distillation. Generates high-quality images in 1-4 steps. Best at: real-time image synthesis with minimal latency. Typical uses: interactive design tools, live preview, quick prototyping. Not suited for: batch processing large datasets.

Dreamshaper-7 fine-tuned text-to-image model based on Stable Diffusion v1.5. Improved LoRA support and artistic quality. Best at: stylized image generation with emphasis on realism and detail. Typical uses: game asset creation, concept art, design mockups. Not suited for: photorealism-only workflows.
